description: This file defines the LessEqualBinary class, a node representing a 'less than or equal to' binary expression within the Twig template engine's expression parser.

classes.name: LessEqualBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary 'less than or equal to' operation node in the Twig abstract syntax tree. It handles code compilation specific to the PHP version.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the binary expression, using a specific comparison method for PHP versions below 8.0.0.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the string operator '<=' for use in compiled code.
